# Yo.Town Docs

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [YoCAD™ Modeling](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/core/cad.md): Yo.Town Maker YoCAD™ Modeling: turn natural language into YoCAD™ code with live 3D previews—great for fast modeling, parametric edits, and design i...
- [Real Crafting](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/core/crafting.md): Real Crafting in Yo.Town Maker: mortise-and-hinge joints, digital sculpting, attach parts, bases and platforms—refine models for display, print pre...
- [Playground](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/core/playground.md): Playground is Yo.Town Maker's interactive 3D workspace for creating, editing, and managing models.
- [Repair](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/core/repair.md): Repair helps you fix holes, breaks, and non-manifold issues in 3D models with quick and advanced modes.
- [AI Segmentation](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/core/segment.md): Yo.Town Maker AI Segmentation: split 3D models into parts quickly with automatic and manual controls—ideal for print-ready part separation and stru...
- [FAQ](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/faq/faq.md): FAQ answers common questions across user scenarios to help you quickly understand product capabilities.
- [Common Features](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/common-features.md): Common Features cover essential creation, editing, and export capabilities available across subscription plans.
- [YT Maker Contests](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/contest.md): YT Maker Contests is a creative competition space that showcases works, encourages learning, and rewards outstanding creators.
- [Convert Model](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/convert.md): Convert Model exports 3D models to multiple formats for printing, sharing, and cross-tool collaboration.
- [Digital Gifts](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/digital-gift.md): Digital Gifts wraps 3D models into personalized gift packages and exports them as GIFs or videos.
- [Discover+Show](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/discover.md): Discover+Show is the community gallery where you discover inspiring works and share your own creations.
- [Featured Goods](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/featured.md): Featured Goods is the official marketplace for curated 3D model products for creative and gifting scenarios.
- [Model Library](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/library.md): Model Library provides curated official 3D resources for browsing, learning, reuse, and inspiration.
- [Music 3D](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/music3d.md): Music 3D combines staff editing with 3D keyboard visualization for intuitive music creation workflows.
- [Artifacts Posts](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/posts.md): Artifacts Posts is your personal work hub for viewing, sharing, copying model share links, deleting works, and opening them in other tools.
- [Pricing](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/pricing.md): Pricing offers tiered subscription plans so individuals and professionals can unlock the features they need.
- [Personal Profile](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/profile.md): Personal Profile lets you manage account information, YCoin balance, and subscription status in one place.
- [3D Recolor](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/recolor.md): 3D Recolor lets you quickly apply and adjust colors on 3D models for vivid, personalized visual styles.
- [Style Transform](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/features/restyle.md): Style Transform transforms 3D models into different artistic styles to create distinctive visual effects quickly.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/getting-started.md): Yo.Town Maker is a powerful 3D model processing and creation platform with rich tools for efficient workflows.
- [Boolean Operations](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/workflow/boolean-operations.md): Learn practical Union, Difference, and Intersection workflows for combining models, cutting holes, and extracting overlaps.
- [Disassembly workflow](https://docs.yotown.com/docs/workflow/disassembly-steps.md): Yo.Town Maker disassembly workflow: full steps from model prep and repair through segmentation to export—quick to learn and easy to repeat.
